slices.title: Parking
slices.summary: Adds RoundsOutcome Parked (credential window, provider exhausted, upstream unavailable, reauth required): the executor writes a park fold and returns status parked without terminalizing, sse.rs emits a raw run_parked frame, and orchestration.proto adds RunParked 24 and RunResumed 25. The recovery worker parks a resumable fold left active by a crash (CrashInterrupted), treats parked and resuming folds like open approvals, and expires unclaimed parks after the TTL to outcome_unknown; ZDR and waived runs never park, and chat-client.ts handles run_parked minimally.
slices.remaining: committed c09d71992 (W1-18); S8-A (executor park, resume, run_parked frame, RunParked 24 / RunResumed 25, chat-client minimal handling, TTL expiry, parked/resuming spare) was already built and live-proven. This pass built the SES

slices.title: Read-only staging into code_interpreter (Ask loop)
slices.summary: Stages validated attachment bytes read-only under attachments/ inside the code_interpreter sandbox for the Ask loop, carried on a new ExecuteStepRequest.attachments (tag 12) and enforced by kernel read-only binds. A shared pure contracts module validates names and sha256, a request-scoped run-inputs registry is zeroed on release, and an unsandboxed host refuses staging. Behind CHAT_SANDBOX_ATTACHMENTS_ENABLED (default off).
